title: Joanna Ampil to play Norma Desmond in ‘Sunset Boulevard’ PH debut
summary: Theater actress Joanna Ampil will play Norma Desmond in the Philippine production of Andrew Lloyd Webber’s musical “Sunset Boulevard,” which is scheduled to open in August 2027.
